correctness.rationale: Chen multiplication gives the seven cubic coordinates. On the source chart the base ideal is \((b,v^3)\), and three successive simple blow-ups principalize it, giving divisor \(3H-E_1-E_2-E_3=-K\). The seven cubics form the complete anticanonical system and are birational on a dense chart. The three anticanonical-degree-zero curves have root configuration \(A_1\sqcup A_2\). Exact elimination yields an \(A_1\) chart \(uv-w^2=0\) and an \(A_2\) chart \(uv-w^3=0\), while the remaining charts are smooth and cover the image. A fresh independent local calculation rechecked the singular normal forms; the bundled exact Groebner verifier checks the full projective ideal and intersection lattice.

originality.rationale: Colmenarejo--Galuppi--Michałek already compute the ideal of exactly \(\mathcal A_{(1,2,1),3}\), prove it toric, determine its exact degree-six lattice polygon with seven lattice points, and distinguish the correct polygon by inspecting tangent spaces at singular points. For a projective toric surface, the singularity types and minimal toric resolution are read directly from the primitive edge cones/normal fan, and the degree-six Gorenstein polygon gives the weak-del-Pezzo anticanonical model. The submitted \(A_1\sqcup A_2\) basket and three-point toric blow-up chain are therefore a routine toric extraction from a stronger published exact description, even though the paper does not print those labels in the same wording.
